verdict.rationale: Gusto documents a day-one business bank account (via Increase Bank) and a Money Dashboard showing cash balance, but nothing in the evidence mentions interest, yield, or any treasury or sweep product on operating cash. Treasury yield is a fair axis for a fintech that offers banking, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can earn yield on operating cash balances without moving funds to a separate institution
